text:
sumi: Quick heads-up — after the q4b int4 bring-up yesterday I'm seeing a clear hallucination regression on the longform de-id holdout. Not huge but actionable (+~3% hallucination). Need curation + golden expansion.

Tomas: ugh. can you paste the eval output? which slices are worst?

sumi: Pasted below — longest summaries (>800 tokens) and cases with lots of inline lists / entity tables.

```
$ rbin eval --model q4b-1.0-int4 --dataset deid-longform-v2 --slices long_summaries,entity_tables
BLEU: 42.1
ROUGE-L: 35.4
Hallucination-rate: 7.8% (+3.1% vs fp16)
Hallucination-severity>1: 3.4% (+2.0%)
Latency p50: 210ms
Throughput: 6.2 tok/s
```

nora: thanks. do we know whether this is quant-only or an inference-kernel mismatch? any changes to kv-cache or batching?

sumi: initial runs were with default serving config. I re-ran with kv-cache disabled and hallucination dropped 0.4% — so KV interaction is small but real. main delta seems to be numeric quantization on attention kernels.

zach: ok we should treat this like a quality regression: expand the golden set with targeted longform examples + ambiguous entity cases. propose: +300 microgolden samples, each labelled by 3 annotators, emphasis on PII masking and hallucination flags.

Tomas: agree. also want to capture reproducible steps for the quant sweep so we can report which kernel/weight-permute combination caused the delta. Nora, can you run a kernel-variant sweep? example flags below:

```
rbin quant-sweep --model q4b-1.0 --bits 4 --kernels aten,fast_attn,flash --permute none,block --kv-cache {on,off} --eval deid-longform-v2
```

labeler-bot: New ticket created: ML-4123 — "q4b int4: longform hallucination regression". Labeling plan attached.

nora: I'll kick off the sweep this morning and attach logs to ML-4123. If we find a clear kernel culprit we can patch the runtime or pin kernel selection for dedicated.

sumi: On dataset/labeling side — proposed microgolden schema:
- 300 long summaries (>=800 tokens) sampled from recent production RAG traffic (deid-filtered)
- 50 adversarial paraphrases per 50 worst examples (synthetic augmentation)
- 3 independent labelers per example, labeler checklist:
  1) confirm source content present and PII masked
  2) mark any invented content as 'hallucination' and add short note
  3) severity 0-3 (0=no issue, 3=high risk)

Tomas: who owns assembling the sample? we should de-dup against existing golden and microgolden sets and keep provenance. Also add a quick checksum and example fingerprint for future drift detection.

zach: I can take assembly + dedupe. plan: sample 1k candidates -> run fuzzyhash dedupe -> surface top 400 for labeler queue -> labelers will confirm final 300. I'll add provenance fields: source_ts, session_id, md5_text.

sumi: labeler instructions text (for ops channel copy):
"When labelling, confirm the answer only uses content from the provided source. If the model adds content not supported by the source, mark 'hallucination' and include the shortest evidence span. For PII, verify mask integrity; if unmasked, escalate to privacy ops."

labeler-bot: Labeling batch created: LB-7892. Estimated ETA for first pass: 48 hrs.

nora: after sweep results in ML-4123, next steps:
- if single kernel shows delta -> rollback kernel or pick kernel override for q4b on Dedicated
- if quant config overall is bad -> we try per-layer mixed precision (int4 on dense except layernorm/attn)
- update Optimize recommendations with a 'longform-int4' profile

Tomas: and for the console, let's add a small dashboard card for 'longform hallucination' that tracks hallu-rate on golden and production slices so we spot re-regressions.

sumi: good. I'll open a console card ticket and add a sample promptset for the dashboard.

zach: thumbs up. starting dedupe -> will ping when LB-7892 is populated.

sumi: thanks all — action items: (1) nora kernel sweep + logs to ML-4123, (2) zach sample assembly + dedupe + create LB queue, (3) labelers start LB-7892, (4) sumi will add dashboard card. ping me for unblockers. :thumbsup:
